about: This site against Wikipedia, both ways. wikipedia_to_us: for each Wikipedia claim, the timeline row (by permanent id) that says the same, the data file that holds it, or that it is missing here. us_to_wikipedia: for each of our key facts, whether each language has the subject, whether it has our time, the revision in which it first appeared and whom it cites. Every relation is our analysis of two bodies of evidence; a pattern match on wikitext finds the subject, not agreement.
attribution: Wikipedia's text is by Wikipedia's contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Each statement here is our own English paraphrase; the anchor is a few words of the article, quoted to find the sentence; the exact revision is linked.

wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence

wikipedia_to_us.statement: Madeira's civil protection logged 38 incidents between 20:00 and 23:30 on 10 November: 15 floodings, five fallen trees, four landslides and others, with 113 responders and 39 vehicles.

wikipedia_to_us.statement: The storm began as a non-tropical low over the western subtropical Atlantic, formed on a weakening front a few hundred miles south of Bermuda in early November.
wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence

wikipedia_to_us.statement: The US National Hurricane Center began following it in its outlooks on 3 November, at a 10% chance of development within 48 hours and 30% within seven days.
wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence

wikipedia_to_us.statement: By 6 November the Center had lowered both chances to 20%, saying the low might only briefly become subtropical before another low absorbed it.
wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence

wikipedia_to_us.statement: On 7 November the Center's outlook labelled the low Invest 94L, several hundred miles south-south-east of Bermuda.
wikipedia_to_us.note: A hidden note left in the wikitext by an editor says the sources do not state that 94L became Charles and asks for it to be checked. Wikipedia itself marks this as unverified.
wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence

wikipedia_to_us.statement: Meteored said Charles kept its subtropical origins as it crossed the Atlantic under the subtropical jet, leaving heavy rain from near Bermuda onward.
wikipedia_to_us.label: our analysis of evidence
